# Josh Taveras (D): NYS Senate, District 8

<!-- Generated by build.py from meta.json and claims.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Josh Taveras's** campaign website ([Meet the Candidate page](https://www.joshtaveras.com/meet-candidate/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Opponent: [Jarett Gandolfo](../gandolfo-jarett/) (R).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/taveras-josh> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

A personal biography and a list of endorsements. Most of it is personal history that public records cannot confirm. His education is described differently across sources.

1. Political science degree from Stony Brook is consistent with Ballotpedia.
2. Branch also lists an engineering degree from NYIT; his own page says he only began in engineering.
